category_title: Highly anxious students with ASD characterized by pervasive sensory rituals and wariness
scenario_title: Seeking reassurance and early termination during play
minimal_context: The student and teacher are in the school dinner hall attempting to play a simple throw and catch game with a ball.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's play a simple throw and catch game with this ball.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits close to the teacher, holding hands and looking to the teacher for reassurance before briefly tossing the ball back.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the ball again. Throw it back.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Watches the dog in order to move away if it gets too close, then becomes preoccupied with following markings on the floor in a repetitive manner.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are still playing. Come back and catch the ball.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves further away from the dog and chooses to leave the room before the end of the session.)
